name: determinants_pd
description: LightGBM partial dependence of CAI, tAI, OSTIR TIR and promoter score, for V15(b) (GIPPA_SPEC.md §10.2; docs/specs/M9-17-plot-support-analysis.md). Grid: the 5 %, 10 %, ..., 95 % quantiles plus min and max of the feature over the model rows, on the feature's own scale. Written by the determinants step. Not a result table.

fields.name: grid_value
fields.description: Grid value on the feature's own scale (tir_ostir is logged before predicting)

fields.name: pd_mean
fields.description: Mean over boosters of each booster's mean prediction over the model rows with the feature set to grid_value

fields.name: pd_low
fields.description: Minimum over boosters of the per-booster partial dependence: a spread over the boosters, not a confidence interval

fields.name: pd_high
fields.description: Maximum over boosters of the per-booster partial dependence: a spread over the boosters, not a confidence interval
